title: RBL Bank Secures Approval for Historic $3 Billion FDI Investment from Emirates NBD
summary: Emirates NBD acquires 49%-74% controlling stake in RBL Bank through ₹26,850 crore ($3B) preferential issue — largest FDI in Indian banking history.

blocks.content: RBL Bank received all regulatory approvals (RBI, SEBI, CCI, DFS) for a **$3 billion (₹26,850 crore)** strategic investment by Dubai-based **Emirates NBD Bank**, acquiring 49-74% controlling stake at ₹280/share.

provenance.sourceTitle: RBL Bank Secures Approval for Historic $3 Billion FDI Investment from Emirates NBD
